arabic text: Kullu Yawmin Aashura, Kullu Ardhin Karbala Ya Abal Ahraar
english translation text: Every day is Ashura; every land is Karbala O father of the free

arabic text:
Maula ay jaan-e-nabi, har ruh kare tujhko salaam
Khune Zehra (AS) tu hai, Haider (AS) hai baba tera
Assalaamu Alayka Ya Hussain, Yabna Aliyyi waz-Zehra
Assalaamu Alayka Ya Maula, Ya Aba Abdillah
(Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum,
Waliyyun Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum)
x2
english translation text:
O Master, soul of the Prophet, every soul sends peace upon you
You are Zahra's blood, and Haider is your father
Peace be upon you, O Hussain, son of Ali and Zahra
Peace be upon you, O Master, O Aba Abdillah
(Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you
A friend to those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you)
x2

arabic text:
Ansaare din-e-Haq ke, har eik hussaini ko salaam
Raazi hai tumse maula, ya’ni ke raazi hai khuda,
Alaykum Minni Jamee’aa, Salaamullahi Abadaa,
Maa Baqiyal Laylu wan-Nahaar, Ya Ansaara Deenillah
(Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum,
Waliyyun Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum)
x3
Ya hussain, ya hussain, ya Hussain, ya Hussain
english translation text:
Peace upon every Hussaini supporter of the true faith
The Master is pleased with you—and therefore God is pleased
From me, peace be upon all of you forever
For as long as night and day remain, O supporters of God's religion
(Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you
A friend to those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you)
x3
O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain

arabic text:
Zaat-e-shahaadat ko panaah, tere gharaane mein mili
Tere lahu se mehki, dine Muhammad (SAW) ki fiza
Assalaamu Alayka Ya Hussain, Yabna sh-Shaheed, Akha sh-
Shaheed
Aba sh-Shuhadaa was-Saaliheen, Ayuha sh-Shaheed bi kerbala
(Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum,
Waliyyun Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum)
x2
english translation text:
Martyrdom itself found refuge within your household
Through your blood, the atmosphere of Muhammad's faith became fragrant
Peace be upon you, O Hussain, son of the martyr, brother of the
martyr
Father of the martyrs and the righteous, O martyr of Karbala
(Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you
A friend to those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you)
x2

arabic text: Jeete ji hun tera, markar bhi tera hi rahun,\nSadqe mein Shabbir ke rakh, saabit qadam mere khuda\nFas’alullaha rabbi, an-yuthabbita lee
english translation text: In life I am yours, and after death may I remain yours\nFor Shabbir's sake, keep me steadfast, my God\nI ask Allah, my Lord, to keep me firm

arabic text:
‘Indakum qadama sidqin, fi d-Dunya wal Aakhira
(Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum,
Waliyyun Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum)
x2
Bi Abi Anta wa Ummi, Ya Hussain
Mere maa(n) baap ho tum par fida
Ya Hussain, Ya Hussain, Ya Hussain, Ya Hussain
english translation text:
With you, upon a truthful footing, in this world and the Hereafter
(Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you
A friend to those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you)
x2
May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Hussain
May my parents be sacrificed for you
O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain

arabic text:
Mein kya mera ghar qurbaa(n), Jinno basher nauha kunaa(n),
Hamko rulaaye ab tak, Maula tera khushk gala,
Bi Abi Anta wa Ummi, Laqad ‘adhumatil museebah
Wa adhumati r-Raziyya, bika ‘alaynaa jamee’aa
(Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum,
Waliyyun Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum)
x2
english translation text:
What am I, and what is my home? Let both be sacrificed; jinn and humankind recite laments
Your parched throat, O Master, still makes us weep
May my father and mother be sacrificed for you; truly immense is the calamity
And immense is the tragedy that has befallen all of us through you
(Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you
A friend to those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you)
x2

arabic text:
"Bande Ali" ye hai dua, "Yawar" ki bas shaam-o-sahar,
Kerbobala dekhun mein, Munh par maluun khaake shifa
Bi Abi Antum wa Ummi, Tibtum wa Taabatil Ardhul,
Llati feeha Dufintum, wa Fuztum Fawzan ‘Adheemaa
Silmun Liman saalamakum, Harbun Liman haarabakum, Waliyyun
Liman Waalaakum, Wa Aduwwun Liman Aadaakum
(Ya Hussain Ya Hussain, Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
english translation text:
This is the prayer of "Bande Ali", and of "Yawar", morning and evening
May I behold Karbala and rub its healing dust upon my face
May my father and mother be sacrificed for you; pure were you, and pure became the land
In which you were buried; you attained a mighty triumph
Peace with those at peace with you; war with those at war with you; a friend
To those who befriend you, and an enemy to those who oppose you
(O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain, O Hussain
